title: 第21章 西门二丝的嫣然一笑第22章 星光如此美好何人如此暴躁
slug: 大罗邪仙苟在剑门当药师
content_zh:
第21章西门二丝的嫣然一笑
“可惜了，这枚妖丹若不爆，还真是不错的炼丹材料！”度凌轻轻一叹。
巨大的凶蟒半截身子从空中砸下。
横断整条黑水河。
度凌一拳击出，巨蟒口腔之中如同利刃一般的獠牙打断，度凌从它口中而出，脚下一点，巨蟒脑袋陷入黑水河中，度凌的身子高高跃起，直上崖顶。
崖顶之上，他的衣服，在一幅白骨骨架上飘着。
衣服重新穿好的那个刹那。
禁区最深处突然传来一道声音……
如风声，亦如末日亡灵之音……
度凌片刻都没有耽搁，猛然俯身，抓起李寒衣的白骨，一跃而起，下谷，再纵，上峰，几个起落，消失得无影无踪。
而刚才的黑水河，刹那间停止了流动。
整方天地似乎时间静止。
一条奇异的骨舟从黑水河深处驰来，骨舟之上，一个青衣老人眉头皱起，脸上满是惊讶。
“竟然可以逆开界锁，何许人也？”
是的，度凌此刻已经越过了黄梁。
没有丝毫拖泥带水。
这道黄梁，理论上无人可以逆向穿越，但他，偏偏就是打破理论的那个人。
剑门关。
夕阳下。
圣女峰紫竹林。

紫竹依依，在夕阳下泛起淡淡的金光。
一条人影在竹林漫步，身影美感无穷。
这是西门二丝在闭关。
她走的是随心随性之道，她修的是最能体现随心随性的“斩天十七式”。
她的闭关方式跟一般人不同。
一般人闭关，进入练功室，关门闭户，盘腿而坐，眼观鼻，鼻观心。
而她，是散步。
这种闭关方式，外人看来，赏心悦目，甚至有诗人写诗赞美曰：仙峰扶摇三千步，始觉人间已百年。
仙峰扶摇步。
人间百年去。
多么浪漫的诗情画意？
多么贴切的闭关描述——修行道上时间不值钱，一个闭关就是百年世事沧桑，也是有的。
然而，这只是外人看来。
真正懂行的人却知道，这种休闲式闭关，很危险。
因为她本质上是在闭关。
她全部心神其实都在体内。
她感知不到外界，而外界的任何一点风吹草动，都会影响到她。
一般情况下，不会有人打扰她。
然而，一条人影穿空而过，无声无息地落在她的面前。
赫然是西门三丝。

西门三丝空中一落，西门二丝脚下突然乱了。
这一乱，她一脚踏下的地方，剑气纵横，三株紫竹，凭空化为飞灰。
峰下几名弟子齐声惊叫。
content_en:
Chapter 21 Ximen Ersi’s charming smile
"What a pity. If this demon pill hadn't exploded, it would have been a good alchemy material!" Du Ling sighed softly.
The huge vicious python smashed half of its body from the air.
Cross the entire Blackwater River.
Du Ling punched out, and the sharp fangs in the python's mouth were broken. Du Ling came out of its mouth. When he stepped a little further, the python's head fell into the black water river. Du Ling's body jumped high and went straight to the top of the cliff.
On the top of the cliff, his clothes were floating on a white skeleton.
The moment I put my clothes back on.
A voice suddenly came from the deepest part of the restricted area...
Like the sound of wind, like the voice of the dead at the end of time...
Du Ling didn't waste a moment. He leaned over suddenly, grabbed Li Hanyi's bones, jumped up, went down to the valley, then up to the peak, and disappeared without a trace after a few ups and downs.
The Blackwater River just stopped flowing in an instant.
The whole world seems to have stopped in time.
A strange bone boat came from the depths of the Blackwater River. On the bone boat, an old man in green frowned, his face full of surprise.
"Who can actually reverse the boundary lock?"
Yes, Du Ling has crossed Huangliang at this moment.
There is no sloppiness at all.
In theory, no one could cross this yellow beam in the opposite direction, but he was the one who broke the theory.
Jianmenguan.
Under the sunset.
The Purple Bamboo Forest of Saint Maiden Peak.
The purple bamboo trees glow with a faint golden light under the setting sun.
A figure walks in the bamboo forest, the figure is infinitely beautiful.
This is Ximen Ersi in retreat.
She follows the path of following one's heart and nature, and what she practices is the "Seventeen Styles of Cutting the Sky" that best embodies the freedom of one's heart and nature.
Her way of retreat is different from other people's.
Ordinary people retreat, enter the practice room, close the door, sit cross-legged, look at the nose with the eyes, and look at the heart with the nose.
And she was taking a walk.
This kind of retreat is pleasing to the eyes of outsiders. Some poets even wrote poems praising it: "Immortal peaks soar three thousand steps before I realize that I have been in the world for a hundred years."
Immortal Peak Swinging Steps.
Hundreds of years pass in this world.
How romantic and poetic?
What an apt description of retreat - time is worthless on the spiritual path, and a retreat is worth hundreds of years of vicissitudes of life.
However, this is only from the perspective of outsiders.
People who really know the industry know that this kind of leisure retreat is very dangerous.
Because she is essentially in retreat.
All her thoughts are actually inside her body.
She cannot sense the outside world, and any disturbance in the outside world will affect her.
Normally, no one would bother her.
However, a figure passed through the air and landed silently in front of her.
It was Ximen Sansi.
Ximen Sansi fell in the air, and Ximen Ersi's feet suddenly became chaotic.
In this chaos, the place where she stepped was filled with sword energy, and three purple bamboos turned into ashes out of thin air.
Several disciples below the peak screamed in unison.
